greeting: Shadow of Marn on comms. Stage 3: Echoes of the Lost. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running Into Darkness. Objective drift gets teams buried.
I saw gravity file for overtime in this sector. Management approved.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Resist the call of the Lost.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Resist the call of the Lost; Use Truth to reveal the deception; Free the trapped souls. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Face manifestations of everyone who has fallen to the Void. Immediate move: Resist the call of the Lost.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 3 resolved: Echoes of the Lost. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for The Hunger Itself.
rumor: A seam flare formed the exact outline of the old capital for six seconds.
People keep repeating one clue from Echoes of the Lost: 'Free the trapped souls'.
I met my future self and we argued about shoe durability.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn is mostly theoretical in the Void. Use checkpoints, not intuition.
dialog.time_noon: Noon seam pulses spike here. Keep anti-glitch protocols active.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk paints safe paths that are not safe. Probe first, trust later.
dialog.time_night: Night in the Void multiplies fear. Keep comms human and constant.

party_reactions.kade: Shadow of Marn sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Shadow of Marn accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Shadow of Marn talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: No speeches. Give me actionable details.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You made it back. Report status.
relationship_dialog.friend: With you here, the odds stop looking stupid.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Same plan as always: adapt, push, survive, repeat.
